9New Business Highlight: East Water STECON Utilities (EWS) 
Joint venture between Eastern Water Resources Development and Management ( Eastwater ) and Stecon  Power a subsidiary of Stecon  Group
40% stake 60% stakeJV Structure
Strategic rationale
Strategically expand our Data Center Ecosystem: 
•Data centers demands significant volume of high -quality and reliable industrial -grade water.
•EWS serves as strategic business for securing water supply to DCs in the EEC area.
Generate consistent income for STECON Group: 
•Long -term industrial water contracts (duration of 10 -20 years) ensure stable recurring income, 
coupled with mitigated risk of water supply via long -term raw water purchase agreement with 
guaranteed water volume and quality
•Attractive commercial pricing structure resulting in higher margins 
Leverage synergistic strengths of both parties:
•EW operates one of the largest water grid network spanning over 550 -km pipeline and water 
reservoirs across the EEC area allocating raw water supply of over 200 million cubic meters annually 
(covering more than 50% of raw water demand in EEC)
•STECON construction expertise which will be synergized for constructing EWS’s plant and STECON 
Group’s strong potential to attract DC clients

## Page 18

18
STECON’s Sustainability Highlights
Circular Economy
The Food Waste to Fertilizer Project at the 
headquarters, construction units, and construction 
support units aims to manage the organization’s 
organic waste. This initiative helps reduce 
greenhouse gas emissions, adds value to organic 
waste, and minimizes environmental impacts. 
From January to August 2025, the project 
successfully converted a total of 12 tons of 
food waste into fertilizer.
The Bangkok Mall Construction Project organized 
a tree -planting activity in collaboration with the 
local community, planting mangrove trees at the 
Army Nature Education Center in Bang Pu, 
Samut Prakan Province . The activity aims to 
reduce air pollution, enhance greenhouse gas 
absorption, and help maintain biodiversity 
balance.

Hydraulic Cement Type 1
January –September 2025, the company used hydraulic cement, which contains environmentally friendly materials. 
The company applied hydraulic cement in all projects, both in powdered form and as ready -mixed concrete, totaling 
136,575.87 tons. This resulted in a reduction of greenhouse gas emissions by 5,326.46 tCO₂e, equivalent to planting 
172,460 trees.

STECON’s Sustainability Highlights: August
“ESG DNA Project” certificate:
Certificate was presented to STECON 
Group and organizations with over 70% of 
their employees completing the 
sustainability foundation course. 
The ESG DNA Project is a sustainability knowledge 
package for personnel at all levels within the 
organization. The ESG DNA program, offered 
through over 20 e -Learning courses, aims to raise 
awareness and instill sustainability DNA in 
employees, enabling them to apply this knowledge 
for sustainable organizational development.

## Page 21

21
STECON’s Sustainability Highlights: September
STECON Group received the Climate Action 
Award 2025 in the "Climate Action Leader 
Award" category at the “Climate Change Forum 
2025: Driving Towards Net Zero” organized by 
the Climate Change Institute (CCI) under the 
Federation of Thai Industries (FTI):
This award represents STECON Group’s commitment to 
sustainable development and motivating teams at all 
levels to work together towards achieving its goal of 
carbon neutrality. STECON Group is committed to 
contributing to positive change for the world and a better 
future for all sectors, through development of innovation, 
work processes, and cooperation with partners to create 
continuous positive environmental impacts.

## Page 22

22
STECON’s Sustainability Highlights: October
STECON Group Public Company Limited (STECON) has 
been awarded a 5 -star “Excellent” Corporate 
Governance Rating (Excellent CG Scoring) and ranked 
in the top quartile among listed companies with a 
market capitalization between 10 billion and 30 billion 
baht. 
The recognition is based on the 2025 Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed 
Companies (CGR) conducted by the Thai Institute of Directors Association (IOD), with the 
support of the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) and the Securities and Exchange 
Commission (SEC).
In addition, STECON achieved a perfect score of 100 points (5 medals) in the 2025 
“Quality Assessment of Annual General Meetings (AGM Checklist)” project organized by 
the Thai Investors Association and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
These achievements reaffirm STECON’s unwavering commitment to upholding the 
highest standards of corporate governance founded on the principles of transparency, 
accountability, and social and environmental responsibility. The company continues to 
align its operations with ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles to 
enhance stakeholder confidence and drive the organization toward stable and sustainable 
growth
